listing.name: Riding Shotgun
listing.summary: Starsector multiplayer for people with no friends. Lets you ride along with your favorite officer in 1 ship and share skills. Or pair your favorite two modded buddies.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a Dual Command Interface hullmod that allows a single ship to have two officers and share skills.

description:
Starsector multiplayer for people with no friends. Lets you ride along with your favorite officer in 1 ship and share skills. Or pair your favorite two modded buddies.

Find a station while exploring to use the "Dual Command Interface" hullmod that allows 1 of your ships to have 2 officers. Works with AI cores on automated ships. There may be some jank, I scanned my own mod directory of about 300 skills and whitelisted/blacklisted what did/didn't work.
Add-able mid-save, the station generates, and has a bar event pointer

aiDescription: Adds a Dual Command Interface hullmod that allows a single ship to have two officers, enabling shared skills and AI core support. The station where the hullmod is found generates dynamically and can be added to existing saves.
